title: Boards + #1 podium + rank tags
desc: Config list of boards (store, value getter, formatter), SurfaceGui rows with headshots, a #1 podium dummy wearing the top player's avatar (rig scale kept), per-board rank attributes and a '[#3 Cash]' chat tag, playtime counter.

title: Live merge + write-on-change
desc: Reads each board's top every minute, merges everyone in the server at their live value so a new win shows instantly, writes only values that changed, request cooldown and name validation on the client remote.

title: Log-scaled values, friends and country boards
desc: Stores huge values as log(value)/log(1.0000001) so they fit an ordered store, a 12s read cache, a friends board (GetFriendsAsync + GetAsync per friend), a country board (LocalizationService) with an opt-out toggle.

title: Sanitise, publish-on-change, merge (excerpt)
desc: Clamps values (NaN/inf/negative/too big) before writing, publishes only changed values on an interval, formats durations and big numbers, and merges cached global entries with live players before sorting.

title: Fastest-time board (inverted ms)
desc: Several boards from one config, including a best-time board that stores MAX_MS - timeMs so a descending sort shows the fastest run first, plus mm:ss.mmm and 1h 2m 3s formatters.

title: Config-driven Knit board service
desc: Knit service that, for each board in a shared config, uploads online players, reads the top 100, attaches cached user infos (display name, verified badge) and fires one signal to clients.

title: Basic ordered store board
desc: The beginner version: GetSortedAsync top 50 into a SurfaceGui scroller with GetNameFromUserIdAsync, and SetAsync helpers with retry.

title: Time-played board (RenanMSV toolbox model)
desc: Self-contained 'most time played' board class from RenanMSV's public model: settings module, score update and board refresh timers, username/thumbnail caches, optional dancing #1 rig.

title: Ordered stores fed from the save + backfill
desc: Writes Wins/XP/Rebirths to ordered stores on every save (math.floor to avoid ValueNotNumeric), a faster ordered-store-only update, and a one-time backfill of known players' saved data.

title: Abbreviated leaderstats (excerpt)
desc: Creates leaderstats with StringValue columns and fills them with FormatNumber text (1.2M) from the profile.

title: Leaderstats mirrored from data values
desc: Clones a leaderstats template and mirrors Money/KillerChance from the player's data folder with GetPropertyChangedSignal.

title: Simplest saved playtime stat
desc: Tutorial-style leaderstats Time counter that saves on leave and BindToClose.

title: GlobalLeaderboard (ordered store board)
desc: One ordered-store board: write-on-change with interval, keep-best UpdateAsync, ascending boards, log-encoded big numbers, daily/weekly period stores, live merge, batched names, OnUpdated callback, Abbreviate helper.

title: LeaderstatsMirror (player list columns)
desc: Builds leaderstats from getter functions and keeps it synced; numeric columns or abbreviated StringValue columns.
